description: Calculate a Zi Wei Dou Shu (紫微斗数) natal chart from a Gregorian birth date, two-hour birth period and gender (give exactly one of hourBranch or hour): twelve palaces with branch, stem, major and minor stars, star brightness, birth-year four transformations (四化), Life and Body palaces, five-element class and decade ranges. Calculation only, no reading. Source: multifate.com/tools/ziwei.

gender.description: male or female (男 or 女).

hour.description: Birth hour 0-23 on the local clock; mapped to its two-hour period. 23 and 0 are both the 子 period of the given date. Give this or hourBranch, never both.

hourBranch.description: Two-hour period of birth as an earthly branch: 子 (23:00-00:59), 丑 (01:00-02:59), ... 亥 (21:00-22:59). A 23:00-23:59 birth stays on the entered date; early and late Zi are not split. Give this or hour, never both.

name: ziwei_chart
title: Zi Wei Dou Shu chart
